rows.reasoning: Petersen co-sponsored SB1457 (2021) and voted Aye on its Senate Final Reading, a bill that makes it a felony to perform an abortion knowing "the abortion is sought solely because of a genetic abnormality of the child." That is a restriction keyed to the reason for the abortion at any stage, so it does not choose between "allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health", "ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life", and "ban abortion in all cases, with no exceptions". The record places him on the restrictive side and no further, so the row is blank.
